coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 11 of 17 ground-truth variable items (65%, rounded): consistent data splits, sequence length, forecast horizon, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, normalization method, cycle-index generation, MSE, MAE, and cyclic-pattern visualizations.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW instead of Adam and does not explicitly specify MSE as the training loss. Specifies 50 epochs instead of 30, batch sizes of 16/32 rather than the referenced 256, and different compute resources instead of a single RTX 4090 with 24GB memory. Synthetic-data generation parameters are absent, and RevIN is always enabled rather than configurable on/off.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the trained CycleNet forecasting outcome and visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
